name: fight_act2_balthazar
title: Act 2 boss: Balthazar in Nightsong's Prison
task: Win the fight: defeat Balthazar and his guards.
scored_by: Passed the first moment a fight is won (a combat that ends with the enemies beaten and the party standing; the one ahead of you is the fight). Nothing else counts toward the score: party members downed or killed, game time and cost are reported next to it.
about: Fight (family 1), a boss: the necromancer and his undead guards in the Gauntlet of Shar's prison, up to twenty enemies in waves. claude-run-2 S040-S041 needed three reloads; the winning try took 8 rounds (291 party HP lost, 2 downs).

note.where: Nightsong's Prison, on the prison floor past the stairs and the bridge, about 11 m from Balthazar; out of combat.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A half-orc paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant.
